newsHighlights.title: Xi: Ensure Stable Supply Chains
newsHighlights.summary: President Xi Jinping pledged that China will work with countries worldwide to uphold the multilateral trading system and keep global supply chains stable and unimpeded.
newsHighlights.translation: 习近平主席承诺，中国将与世界各国一道维护多边贸易体制，确保全球供应链稳定畅通。

newsHighlights.title: NEV Share of New Car Sales Hits New High in September
newsHighlights.summary: New energy vehicles accounted for a record 61.6 percent of China's monthly new car sales in September, according to the China Association of Automobile Manufacturers.
newsHighlights.translation: 据中国汽车工业协会数据，9月份新能源汽车占中国月度新车销量的61.6%，创下历史新高。

newsHighlights.title: China's CPI Up 0.9% in September
newsHighlights.summary: China's consumer price index rose 0.9 percent year-on-year in September, signaling a mild recovery in consumer demand and price stability.
newsHighlights.translation: 9月份中国居民消费价格指数同比上涨0.9%，显示出消费需求温和回暖和物价稳定。

newsHighlights.title: Premier Li Calls for Cooperation in Global Industrial and Supply Chains
newsHighlights.summary: Premier Li Qiang urged deeper international cooperation to build resilient global industrial and supply chains amid rising geopolitical uncertainty.
newsHighlights.translation: 李强总理呼吁在地缘政治不确定性上升的背景下深化国际合作，构建具有韧性的全球产业链供应链。

newsHighlights.title: Xi Sends Congratulatory Letter to 140th Canton Fair
newsHighlights.summary: President Xi Jinping sent a congratulatory letter to the 140th Canton Fair, underscoring China's continued opening-up and commitment to shared global prosperity.
newsHighlights.translation: 习近平主席向第140届广交会致贺信，强调中国将持续扩大开放，致力于与世界共享繁荣。

quote.quote: In the middle of difficulty lies opportunity.
quote.author: Albert Einstein
quote.explanation: 这句名言提醒我们，在全球供应链波动与经济转型的挑战中，往往孕育着创新与合作的新机会。正如中国新能源汽车产业的崛起，正是在能源转型的挑战中抓住了机遇。

vocabulary.definition: 供应链（从原材料到最终产品交付的全过程网络）
vocabulary.example: China is committed to ensuring the stable and unimpeded operation of global supply chains.
vocabulary.translation: 中国致力于确保全球供应链稳定畅通运行。
vocabulary.newsContext: 来自新闻《Xi: Ensure stable supply chains》的核心关键词。

vocabulary.example: China will continue to uphold the multilateral trading system alongside other countries.
vocabulary.translation: 中国将继续与其他国家共同维护多边贸易体制。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自习近平主席关于维护多边贸易体制的讲话。

vocabulary.example: New energy vehicles accounted for a record 61.6 percent of China's monthly new car sales in September.
vocabulary.translation: 9月份新能源汽车占中国月度新车销量的比例创纪录地达到61.6%。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自《NEV share of new car sales hits new high in Sept》中描述新能源汽车销量占比。

vocabulary.definition: 居民消费价格指数（衡量通货膨胀的重要指标）
vocabulary.example: China's consumer price index rose 0.9 percent year-on-year in September.
vocabulary.translation: 9月份中国居民消费价格指数同比上涨0.9%。
vocabulary.newsContext: 来自《China's CPI up 0.9% in September》中的关键经济指标。

vocabulary.definition: 同比的（与去年同期相比）
vocabulary.example: The CPI increased 0.9 percent year-on-year, indicating mild inflationary pressure.
vocabulary.translation: 消费者价格指数同比上涨0.9%，显示出温和的通胀压力。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自CPI新闻中用于描述经济数据同比变化的标准表达。

vocabulary.definition: 有韧性的；能迅速恢复的
vocabulary.example: Premier Li called on nations to build resilient global industrial and supply chains.
vocabulary.translation: 李强总理呼吁各国构建有韧性的全球产业链供应链。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自《Premier Li calls on cooperation in global industrial and supply chains》。

vocabulary.example: The Canton Fair demonstrates China's unwavering commitment to opening-up and international trade.
vocabulary.translation: 广交会彰显了中国坚定不移推进对外开放和国际贸易的决心。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自《Xi sends congratulatory letter to 140th Canton Fair》。

vocabulary.definition: 畅通无阻的；不受阻碍的
vocabulary.example: Xi stressed the importance of keeping global trade flows stable and unimpeded.
vocabulary.translation: 习近平强调保持全球贸易流稳定畅通的重要性。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自《Xi: Ensure stable supply chains》原文表述。

vocabulary.example: The new regulation mandates stricter disclosure requirements for listed companies.
vocabulary.translation: 新规定要求上市公司履行更严格的信息披露义务。
vocabulary.newsContext: 关联今日商业金融政策类新闻中常见的政策执行术语。

vocabulary.example: The NEV sector maintained strong growth momentum through the first three quarters of the year.
vocabulary.translation: 新能源汽车行业在今年前三季度保持了强劲的增长势头。
vocabulary.newsContext: 出自NEV销量新闻中描述行业增长态势的语境。

pattern.pattern: account for + 百分比 + of + 总量（占据……的百分之……）
pattern.example: New energy vehicles accounted for a record 61.6 percent of China's monthly new car sales in September.
pattern.translation: 新能源汽车在9月份占中国月度新车销量的61.6%，创下纪录。
pattern.usage: 该句型常用于新闻和报告中描述某一部分在总量中所占的比例。注意：account for 后接百分比时，谓语动词通常用过去式或现在时，视时间语境而定。类似表达还有：make up / constitute / represent + 百分比 + of。

grammar.title: 过去分词作后置定语与状语（Past Participle as Modifier）
grammar.explanation: 在新闻英语中，过去分词（如 highlighted, shown, reported）常放在名词后作后置定语，或放在句首作状语，表示被动或完成的含义。这种结构能使句子更简洁紧凑，是新闻写作的典型特征。例如：'data showed' 省略为 'data shown'；'which was highlighted' 简化为 'highlighted'。
examples: Mining cooperation with Africa highlighted at talks was seen as a new growth point for bilateral trade.
The figures, released by the China Association of Automobile Manufacturers, showed a record NEV market share.

pronunciation.tips: 注意重音在第二个音节 /ˈzɪl/，首音节 /rɪ/ 要弱读。/liənt/ 中的 /iə/ 是双元音，要连贯滑动。整体语调：ri-ZIL-yənt。常见错误是把重音放在第一个音节。
examples: Global supply chains must be resilient enough to withstand future shocks.
The Chinese economy has proved remarkably resilient amid global uncertainties.

reading.title: China Champions Stable Supply Chains as NEV Market Hits Record High
reading.content:
China is stepping up efforts to keep global supply chains stable and open. On Wednesday, President Xi Jinping reaffirmed China's commitment to working with countries around the world to uphold the multilateral trading system and ensure the unimpeded flow of trade. Premier Li Qiang echoed this message, urging deeper international cooperation to build resilient global industrial and supply chains.

At home, the economy showed fresh signs of vitality. New energy vehicles accounted for a record 61.6 percent of China's monthly new car sales in September, data from the China Association of Automobile Manufacturers showed. Meanwhile, the consumer price index rose 0.9 percent year-on-year, reflecting mild but steady consumer demand.

The 140th Canton Fair, which received a congratulatory letter from President Xi, also highlighted China's continued opening-up. Together, these developments signal that China remains a driving force for global trade and green growth.
reading.translation:
中国正在加大力度维护全球供应链的稳定与开放。周三，习近平主席重申中国致力于与世界各国共同维护多边贸易体制，确保贸易畅通无阻。李强总理呼应了这一表态，呼吁深化国际合作，构建有韧性的全球产业链供应链。

在国内，经济展现出新的活力。中国汽车工业协会数据显示，9月份新能源汽车占中国月度新车销量的61.6%，创历史新高。与此同时，居民消费价格指数同比上涨0.9%，反映出温和而稳定的消费需求。

收到习近平主席贺信的第140届广交会也彰显了中国持续扩大开放的决心。这些进展共同表明，中国仍是全球贸易和绿色发展的重要推动力量。
reading.sourceNote: 本文基于2026年10月15日中国日报（China Daily）与CGTN关于全球供应链合作、新能源汽车销量、CPI数据及第140届广交会的真实新闻改写，改写后约165词。
